summary: A typed Samantha tool that answers FAILED, TECHNICAL_FAILURE or DENIED no longer shows its journey step as done: the live tool frame's result is read (first text, closed outcome set) and the step is recorded as a tool error (shown skipped), like an engine error.
reason: S24 07/11 16:07: the typed Orange read returned {"state":"FAILED",…} with isError false, so the journey showed « Je lis ton solde Orange » done (803 ms) while the answer said no balance was read.

tests.name: openclaw-plugin-mobile-ui/scripts/test-run-journey-steps.cjs
tests.evidence: The real 16:07 typed result (isError false, state FAILED) replayed on the observer gives the step state skipped with its 803 ms and a tool.error event; COMPLETED and NEEDS_CONFIRMATION stay successes; unreadable results keep the engine's verdict.

capabilities.reason: Display of an existing tool step only; no route, action or capability change.

architecture.reason: Same observer and progress projection; it reads the result already present in the tool frame.

limitations: The app shows the step as skipped (not done); the run itself keeps its answer and state.
rollback: Revert this commit and redeploy the previous Companion.
